title: fix(cli,i18n,console): the hosted product reads "ObjectOS Cloud" everywhere; the Community Console carries a "Powered by ObjectStack" mark
body:
Fixes #26136

## What changed

ObjectOS is one product in three editions — Community (this repository's runtime and Console, open source), Cloud (cloud.objectos.ai) and Enterprise — and ObjectStack is the name of the protocol, SDK, CLI and framework (maintainer ruling 2026-10-26 13:18Z, model 2). The hosted product is "ObjectOS Cloud" wherever a user reads it; this PR flips the places that still said "ObjectStack Cloud" and gives the Community Console its "Powered by ObjectStack" mark.

- **`packages/cli`** (string literals and help text only): `os cloud login` / `logout` / `whoami`, `os package publish` and `os plugin publish` descriptions, the `--url` / `--server` / `--token` / `--visibility` flag descriptions, the printed headers ("ObjectOS Cloud Login" / "Logout" / "Identity"), the "Not logged in to ObjectOS Cloud" prescriptions in `whoami`, `package publish` and `cloud-config`, the shared "Authentication required" message in `api-client.ts`, and the `os serve` welcome page's link text to the cloud console. Internal identifiers are untouched: `~/.objectstack/cloud.json`, `OS_CLOUD_API_KEY`, `OS_CLOUD_URL`, `OS_TOKEN`, the `os cloud …` command ids.
- **`packages/cli/README.md`** (3 rows) and **`content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`** (6 lines).
- **`README.md`**: the one phrase the slimmed README from PR 26148 still carried (that PR merged at 14:13Z, so this branch merged `origin/main` and fixed it, per the dispatch order's serial constraint).
- **`ui/packages/i18n`**: the four cloud-connection / cloud-install strings in all ten locales (`cloudConnection.bound.title`, the two `dialogDescPicker`s and `signInFirst`) name "ObjectOS Cloud", the product name kept untranslated inside each locale's own sentence; `zh`'s title read "已连接到 ObjectStack 云" and now reads "已连接到 ObjectOS Cloud". New key `auth.shell.poweredBy` in all ten locales (the `ja` value keeps the English wordmark line, listed beside `publicForm.poweredBy` in the untranslated-identity allowlist with the same reason).
- **`ui/packages/app-shell`**: new `isDefaultProductName()` on the runtime-config module and the barrel: true while `branding.productName` equals the default `'ObjectOS'`, false once a runtime has pushed its own.
- **`ui/apps/console`**: `AuthLayout` (the shell of every unauthenticated page: login, register, forgot/reset password, verify email, setup, consent, device, invitation) renders a small "Powered by ObjectStack" link to https://objectstack.ai under the form when `isDefaultProductName()` is true. The wordmark, `logo.svg`, `manifest.json`, the default `productName: 'ObjectOS'` and `admin@objectos.ai` are unchanged.
- **`scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/i18n.json`**: re-recorded by `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` (the gate hashes `ui/packages/i18n` sources; the manifest artefact itself is byte-identical).
- Changeset `.changeset/26136-objectos-cloud-naming.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/cli`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console`.

## Why the sign-in page, and why "productName equals the default"

The sign-in layout already reads the server-driven product name, so it is the one surface where "is this deployment branded?" is already answered; every auth page shares it, and it is the first screen a Community user sees. The About / footer surface was not given a second copy: one place, one rule.

How `branding` reaches the layout: `initRuntimeConfig()` fetches `/api/v1/runtime/config` at boot and merges `body.branding` into the app-shell singleton; `getProductName()` reads it. The payload carries no explicit edition key, so the only reliable signal of "server-pushed branding" is that `productName` differs from the default. That is what `isDefaultProductName()` reads, and the PR says so here as the order asked. Measured at source: `objectstack-ai/cloud` pushes `CLOUD_PRODUCT_NAME = 'ObjectOS Cloud'` (`packages/app-cloud/src/product-name.ts`), and a cloud-connected runtime pushes its workspace name (`packages/cloud-connection/src/runtime-config-plugin.ts`, `productName ← branding.workspace_name`), so both read as branded and get no second line. A logo or colour pushed without a name change does not count as a rebrand here (said in the predicate's doc comment).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## How verified (worktree at the final head, see the report comment for the sha)

- `node packages/cli/bin/run-dev cloud login --help` and `… package publish --help` print "ObjectOS Cloud" (flag descriptions and command description), no "ObjectStack Cloud".
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2` under the verify lock on the merged tree: 333 of 334 files passed, 4876 of 4877 tests; the one red, `src/utils/boot-preparation-parity.test.ts`, was a 5 s timeout while a gate sweep shared the box, and the file passes alone under the lock (37 of 37; it reads `serve.ts` source, which this PR touches in one string). The two `published-subpath-*.pin` suites need `packages/cli/dist`, built first. the new `test/cloud-product-name.test.ts` pins the five commands' descriptions and flag descriptions on "ObjectOS Cloud" and asserts no "ObjectStack Cloud" in any of their help strings. The `integration` tier and the nightly `cloud-login-json-ndjson.e2e` tier (whose `not.toContain('ObjectOS Cloud Login')` pin flipped with the header) are CI's.
- `ui`: `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/AuthLayout.powered-by.test.tsx apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/LoginPage.layout-12600.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/runtime-config.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/product-neutral-renderer.ratchet.test.ts packages/i18n/` → 91 files / 1448 tests passed. The new `AuthLayout.powered-by` test boots branding through a stubbed `GET /api/v1/runtime/config` into the real singleton: default → mark with href `https://objectstack.ai`; `productName: 'ObjectOS'` plus a colour → mark; `'ObjectOS Cloud'` → no mark; `'Acme Studio'` plus a logo → no mark.
- `pnpm --dir ui --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`, `… @object-ui/console run type-check`, `… @object-ui/i18n run type-check`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: all exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui run check:i18n-keys` (every `defaultValue` equals its `en` value) and `check:i18n-drift` (4 changed `en` values, 36 pack values followed, 1 key added) exit 0.
- Derived gate subset (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`) run on the final tree; the full list, each exit code and the `--ran` reconciliation are in the report comment. `check:sdui-manifest`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and spec `check:skill-examples` pass after a full build. `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` is NOT MEASURED here: it pins a fixture to a commit this shallow checkout cannot reach; CI runs it on a full checkout.

## Acceptance notes

- `git grep -n "ObjectStack Cloud" -- ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'` went from 123 lines (at the branch base, a335f1de) to 59 on this branch's final head. Inside the card's surface the only residue is developer-facing code comments in `packages/cli/src` and its test files (file headers such as "authenticate against the ObjectStack Cloud", "ObjectStack Cloud's control plane" in the migration helpers' comments) — left as they are because the dispatch order limited `packages/cli/src/**` to string literals and help text; a user never reads them, and the new unit test names the stale phrase on purpose. Flipping those comments is a mechanical follow-up if the seat wants the grep at zero inside `packages/cli`.
- The same phrase survives outside the card's surface, user-facing in places: `content/docs/deployment/cloud-connection.mdx` (title and description), `content/docs/deployment/index.mdx`, `content/docs/deployment/publish-and-preview.mdx`, `content/docs/protocol/objectql/schema.mdx`, `content/docs/protocol/kernel/metadata-service.mdx`, `content/docs/ui/setup-app.mdx`, `content/docs/kernel/services-checklist.mdx`, `ROADMAP.md`, four package READMEs (`adapters/hono`, `drivers/driver-memory`, `services/service-package`, `services/service-cluster-redis`), and one runtime string served in HTTP 501 bodies and pinned by tests and the platform checklist: `packages/spec/src/system/core-services.zod.ts` "Provided by @objectstack/service-ai in ObjectStack Cloud/Enterprise". Listed in the report for the seat; not edited here. `content/docs/releases/**` and CHANGELOGs are history and stay.
- `ui/AGENTS.md` and `ui/docs/adr/0060-product-neutral-renderer.md` say "ObjectStack Cloud" as a product example; both are governed surfaces and are not touched.
- `ui/scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` still reads `ui/.changeset` and reports this change as undeclared, while this repository's changeset for ui packages lives in the root `.changeset/` (every ui PR merged today does the same); no workflow in this repository runs that script. An observation, not a card: zero pull.
- The commit trailer pair is the model-free pair `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` requires and the pre-push hook enforces; the dispatch order's trailer text, which names a model, was not used.
